(roe) ENERGY COMBAT
* Energy attack costing 4 stages.
DAMAGE: 3 life cards.
HIT: You may banish any of your Styled Drills.
Your opponent destroys the top X cards of his
Life Deck. X = the number of Drills you banished
+ your MP's current level.
